Definition: from G206 and θίς (a heap); properly (in the plural) the top of the heap, i.e. (by implication) best of the booty:--spoils.
BiblicalUsage: Once, of Abraham's gift to Melchizedek: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils. The word is the top of the heap — the best of the booty, the choicest part of what was taken in battle.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for the best of the spoils carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is Hebrews' argument, that the patriarch gave his best tenth to a greater priest.
